# S401 — Scrollable help overlay

*Proposed.* With help open, up/down (and j/k) scroll it a line and pgup/pgdown a page. Help lines wrap instead of being clipped or shortened, so every key and its full label can be read at 80x24.

**Findings:** 2026-11-17 spec draft from S231 (S69 item 5) and S232 (S67 item 6), owner decision adj 439. The help body is windowed from the top with no way to move it: `m.showHelp` sends `helpLines` to the body (`internal/tui/view.go:79-80`), the window starts at 0 because no row is selected (`view.go:310-335`), and the row keys do nothing under help (`internal/tui/model.go:803-805`). At 80x24 the Roadmap help ends with `+8 more lines` (`testdata/golden/roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:21`), and help lines are clipped (`enter open run, question, item or decision; other rows se...`, same golden line 11) or shortened (`l launch`, `view.go:879-884`). · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

## Why

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): adj 439 (Q4), the help overlay becomes scrollable (up/down, pgup/pgdn), so the 80x24 help has no line that cannot be reached; labels stay full.

Re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S231, S69 item 5, still present. At 80x24 the Roadmap help shortens `l launch a ready slice (Roadmap)` to `l launch` when `O slicer tui` joins the line (`internal/tui/view.go:879-884`; `testdata/golden/roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:15`). `docs/dashboard.md:2176-2178` documents the shortening.
- S232, S67 item 6, still present. The 80x24 Roadmap help ends `+8 more lines` (`roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:21`), and no key reaches those lines: `RowNext`/`RowPrev` return at once under help (`internal/tui/model.go:803-805`), and the window start is computed only from a selected row (`view.go:310-312`). `docs/dashboard.md:2181-2182` says the help body is clipped at 80x24.
- Help lines are clipped with `...` (`clip`, `internal/tui/overview.go:1470-1478`, used throughout `helpLines`, `view.go:759-900`).

Interpretation for the owner to confirm at the UI pass: the window keeps its dim `+N lines above` and `+N more lines` markers as scroll cues (`view.go:998-1012`); "no cut" means every line can be scrolled into view.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests above and see them red.
2. `model.go`: add a help scroll offset. With help open, `up`/`k` and `down`/`j` move it by one line, `pgup`/`pgdown` by the body height minus the marker lines; clamp it so the last page ends flush. Opening help sets it to 0. Do not change the row cursor.
3. `view.go`: when help is shown, the window starts at the help offset (clamped as `windowStart(len(body)-1, ...)` does). In `helpLines`, wrap each line at the body width with a two-space hang (as `wrapText` does) instead of `clip`; remove the `l launch ready slice` / `l launch` shortening (`view.go:879-884`).
4. `keys.go`: when help is open and its body does not fit, the hint offers the scroll keys first.
5. `go test ./internal/tui -update`; review every changed golden; run without `-update`.
6. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md`: help scrolls with up/down and pgup/pgdown, keeps full labels, and starts at the top each time it opens; replace the 80x24 clipping and shortening sentences (`:2176-2182`). CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.
7. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
